Additional independent XPS storage-offload audit (post-outcome; no new games or runtime approval): verified the ORIGINAL finalized artifact13365609151 ZIP is exactly351,880,028 bytes / SHA256 `bcbd2e27ff64dc585f7341aa32ae506ea9819903c1893db8a723ba91c7036ad6`, with2194 unique members and18 whole `.battle.gz` recordings.

Without importing the candidate or harness reducer, I streamed all18 original recordings and independently verified every recording's whole-byte SHA, all300 official round endpoints and contiguous tick sequences, participant names/versions/setup, registered game IDs/arms/seeds/ports, fresh-process/empty-writable-directory declarations, complete start/end/stats markers, zero own skips and the registered integer timing limit. All18 recorded primary shares, scores, official first-place counts and timing values reconcile. This bounded audit does not claim to repeat every one of the separate checkpoint's6150 combat-field/2217 authority checks or remotely rehash unexported worker binaries.

The frozen confirmation decision is independently reproduced: candidate Diamond equal-game mean54.12100553% versus baseline56.43873576%, delta−2.31773022pp against required>=+2pp. Candidate95/120 official first places versus baseline101/120; five of six candidate Diamond games exceed50%. Retcon candidate93.74743222% versus baseline93.08497595%,30/30 first places for each. Every other frozen confirmation gate passes; **diamondDeltaAtLeast2pp is the sole failed gate**, so canonical `not confirmed` stands. This is a finite engineering rejection, not a new significance/general-strength or isolated-causality claim. Screen120 and confirmation300 remain separate; no pooling, replacements or receipt resets.

The original outcome is complete; the repeated Mac ENOSPC described in checkpoint6643448192 concerns later publication, not invalid battle/runtime evidence. A separately coordinated evidence-only XPS offload may retain the exact ZIP in verbatim content-addressed parts and reference all18 whole recordings as indexed original ZIP members, provided full-member byte/hash/metadata verification succeeds. No need to duplicate their large payloads. Preservation success cannot waive the rejected competitive gate or promote KeelHelm. PR108 and its source branch remain owner-controlled and untouched; this comment is not its merge clearance. No new benchmark/strategy or owner-chat message was performed.
